answer: We establish Sybil resistance by anchoring recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments to sequential delay functions, where the hardware limits of copper interconnects prevent parallelized cloning. This framework positions adversary constraints on a thermodynamic ledge, transforming the network into a self-securing garden of verifiable identities. By binding identities to these non-parallelizable proofs, the information-theoretic cost of spoofing exceeds any potential Byzantine utility.
